part2.question: Describe a famous person in your local area

segments.v: I want to talk about Ms. Hạnh. She is a maths teacher at my school. She is famous in my area because she makes TikTok videos about maths. She started two years ago. In her videos she explains maths problems in a funny and easy way. She uses things in daily life to explain maths. Now she has many followers, about 500,000 people. Many students watch her videos to study. She is popular because her videos are useful and free. Many students are afraid of maths but her videos help them. Parents also like her very much. I think she is a great teacher. I like her because she is kind and funny. She is famous but she is still humble. I hope I can be like her in the future.
